name: Aretas
description: King of the Arabians, before whom Jason was accused when he fled from city to city after his failed assault on Jerusalem

points: In the end therefore he had an unhappy return: accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians, fleeing from city to city, pursued of all men, hated as a forsaker of the laws, and being had in abomination as an open enemy of his country and countrymen, he was cast out into Egypt. Thus he that had driven many out of their country perished in a strange land, retired to the Lacedemonians (that is Sparta); and he that had cast out many unburied had none to mourn for him, nor any solemn funerals at all, nor sepulchre with his fathers. All that evil he did came back on him.

Jason, the wicked Israelite who slew his own citizens without mercy, fled again into the country of the Ammonites, and in the end was accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians. Why? Because by that time the Arabs controlled the land of the Ammonites.
